player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Countdown numbers game!
Goal: Combine numbers using +, -, *, / to reach the target.
Action format: [i j op] where i,j are indices and op is the operation.
Example: [0 2 *] multiplies number at index 0 with number at index 2.
Division must result in whole numbers only.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: A lingbi a duti nde na yâ ti wungo 0-{max_index}
invalid_move.invalid_operation: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti sara kua so (ti kangbi ye na zero wala mbeni wungo kue ape)

outcome.win: Aye so ala yeke gi ayeke tâ nzoni mingi. {target}
outcome.turn_limit: Ködörö tî kpa ti ngû. Ködörö ngä ti mbï: {best_value} (sêse: {target})
